person_note: The quote set repeatedly presents Stella, Desiree, Jude, Kennedy, Reese, Early, and other characters from a nonparticipating narrator's position, often through close free-indirect access to their thoughts. Numerous generic-you aphorisms are not sustained second-person narration, and all visible I/we passages occur in character dialogue. The authorized excerpts independently sustain third-person prose, while two explicit whole-book guides identify shifting limited/free-indirect third person. Reports of multiple narrators or viewpoints therefore describe changes in focal character, not changes in grammatical narrative person. The main scope limitation is that the authorized prose covers the opening/Chapter 1 rather than every section, but the distributed interior quotes and whole-book structural sources resolve that limitation without credible contrary evidence.
